<!-- pr-reviewer: f122474d5bd10e71f01adc196839436172289f28 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (Safety-floor change, so read at full rigour; no blockers found.)

**What looks good**
- The rim widens only in the Thread arm (`generate.rs:2052-2058`), by exactly `THREAD_DEPTH_PER_PITCH * tool.pitch` (the same depth the generator cuts), and only the loop that is the hole's own minor rim gives way (`material_source.rs` `major_rims`); every other wall stays. Other op kinds never reach it.
- The solid-law grant (`thread_bore.rs`) is narrow: needs the facet to be the thread's own material (near-vertical wall wholly on the declared circle, or a mouth facet at/above entry) AND the swept cutter to stay inside the major cylinder. `thread_bores` returns empty for non-Thread params and a bad pitch; `solid_hits` is unchanged (empty bores).
- Both sides are pinned: matched passes (air, real drilled hole, stock source) and convicts (major reaches a wall, declared wider than the model hole, floor below the model floor). The crossing change has a keep-conviction test down to 0.001 rad.
- No unwrap/expect/panic added; non-finite depth/pitch refused by name.

**Local results** (trial-merged with upstream/main; already up to date, no conflicts)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| sim: lib, crossing_buckets, crossing_retrace, fixture_mesh_convict, model_excess, overhang_laws, posed_rapids, vertical_rapids | all pass (70/3/2/5/4/13/5/16) |
| app: thread_mill_rim | 6 pass |
| app: mill2d_c 9, solid_law 4, solid_law_goldens 1, verify_arc_reading 7, drill_prior 12, golden_cl 25 | all pass |
| clippy `-p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the rest of the quick plan's broad app/motion list (the author reports the full batch tier green on c770b35c). `thread_mill` and `coarse_rims` suites do not exist on main (they live on #1005/#1045/#1073).

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. `crossing.rs` `touching` is the one change reaching every op's verify. `orient/len` is the distance to the infinite line, so a proper crossing is only excused when an endpoint is within 1 nm of the other chord's line; it is sound for the cases tested, but a maintainer may want the all-ops batch noted as the evidence (the author ran it).
2. "Matched tool" here means the tool's own pitch drives both the helix depth and the widened rim, so a wrong-pitch tool cuts (and is judged) to its own deeper circle; rejecting a pitch/form mismatch against the hole is the tool-law of #1005, not this PR. Worth confirming that intent.
3. Ordering: `git merge-tree` shows a textual conflict in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` against both #1005 (needs-rework) and #1045; the two also conflict with each other's files. This PR is small and independent, so merging it first and having #1005/#1045 re-merge main (keep the `major_rims` call and the `contain_into` bores arg in the Thread arm) is the cheapest order.
4. Size growth: `generate.rs` is far over ~400 lines already (+14 here), not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d9b36d6a3c6d098576a5f90ac01b34c4ca083f2a -->
**Needs changes before merge** - one small thing: the new test file no longer compiles against current main. The law change itself looks right.

I trial-merged d9b36d6a with current main (it merges without git conflicts) and re-read b89eabbb at the safety-floor.

### What looks good (b89eabbb)
- The cap is now `wall + (major - minor) + allow`, where `wall` is the hit facet's own nearest on-band vertex radius (`thread_bore.rs`, `wall_radius` / `holds`). The band only recognises the wall; it no longer sets the limit.
- The grant cannot exceed the real thread depth: it is the model's wall radius plus the declared thread depth plus the law's allowance. A hole drawn wider than declared lifts the model wall, but the helix is still held to model wall plus depth, so a declared hole wider than the model's by more than the allowance convicts (`a_declared_hole_wider_than_the_models_by_a_hair_convicts`). A model hole wider than declared does not give extra reach beyond the thread depth past its own wall.
- Taking the nearest vertex of the facet (not the farthest) is the conservative side on a tessellated wall: a vertex inside the band gives a smaller grant, never a bigger one.
- Floors are still never excused, a helix past the major circle or past the model's wall still convicts, and the matched cases still hold (`a_matched_thread_mill_in_air...`, `..._in_a_drilled_hole...`, `a_matched_thread_stays_clean_at_other_sizes_and_through`). Off-centre declarations are pinned both ways (`..._off_the_models_centre_by_a_hair_convicts`, 5 um stays clean).
- `major_rims` now grows a through hole's major circle from the model's own rim loop when that is nearer the declared centre; the reduced-fidelity limit is documented, with the containment solid law as the backstop.
- Scope is unchanged since the earlier clean look: the grant reaches only Thread ops (`thread_bores` is empty otherwise; `contact.rs` / `rapids_posed.rs` still pass `&[]`).
- d9b36d6a is a clean merge of main (empty remerge diff).

### Local results (merged with main d9b36d6a + upstream/main, macOS)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test thread_mill_rim` | does NOT compile as pushed (below); 9/9 pass once fixed locally |
| `camcraft-sim --lib` | 86 passed |
| `camcraft-sim --test crossing_retrace` | 2 passed |
| app `verify` | 21 passed, 2 ignored |
| app `mill2d_c` | 9 passed |
| app `solid_law` | 4 passed |
| app `solid_law_goldens` | 5 passed |
| app `golden_cl` | 25 passed |
| app `drill_prior` | 12 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean (with the one-line fix below) |

I did not run `coarse_laws` (known main red, #1176).

```
error[E0063]: missing field `turning` in initializer of `camcraft_app::tools::Tool`
   --> crates/app/tests/thread_mill_rim.rs:131:5
```

### Requested before merge
1. `crates/app/tests/thread_mill_rim.rs:131` (`thread_mill()`): main now has `Tool.turning` (e1fc569a, "surface speed and feed per rev for lathe tools"), so the literal needs `turning: None,` after `orientation: None,`. With that line the whole file passes (9/9) and clippy is clean. Please merge main once more, add it, and re-run `thread_mill_rim`. Nothing else was needed.

### Notes (not blocking)
- #1005 and #1045 are still open and both touch the thread-mill path in `generate.rs`; the trial merge of this PR with main has no git conflict there today. Whichever of those lands after this will need a re-merge around the `major_rims` call (~line 2078) and the `contain_into` bores argument. Not a blocker here.
- The decision file records the review round and the crossing-law scope note well.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 434a464a59d6789d665f3d2dc7f7822dd9fa3c55 -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

Re-review at 434a464a. I trial-merged it with current main (62a2c93a) with no conflicts. Then I re-read the whole grant at the safety floor and probed it with throwaway local tests (not pushed).

### Earlier requests
- **Review of f122474d (a declared hole wider than, or off the centre of, the model's hole overcut silently): fixed.** The band now only recognises the wall. The cap is the hit facet's own radius plus H plus `allow`. `major_rims` grows the circle from the model's rim loop. All the cases I gave are pinned and convict.
- **Review of d9b36d6a (`Tool.turning` missing in the fixture): fixed.** `thread_mill_rim` compiles and passes, 9/9.

### What looks good
- The floor is still never excused: `a_thread_taken_below_the_models_hole_floor_convicts`.
- A wall of a different radius still stands (`a_thread_whose_major_circle_reaches_a_wall_convicts`).
- A holder or a wider shank fails `holds`.
- The grant reaches only Thread ops: `thread_bores` is empty for other kinds, and `contact.rs` / `rapids_posed.rs` pass `&[]`.
- Taking the nearest vertex is the conservative choice among a facet's vertices.
- A cutter whose centre sits inside material is still caught by the ray-parity backstop after the facet loop. I checked this for a boss mistaken for a hole: the grant cannot mill away a boss whose edge matches the declared circle.
- No unwrap, expect or panic outside tests. Provenance is on `thread_bore.rs`. No snapshot PNG, golden, dependency, build.rs, `.github`, script or process file is touched. The decision file records both rounds. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #1071`.

### Local results (merged with main 62a2c93a, Windows)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app `thread_mill_rim` | 9/9 |
| app `mill2d_c` / `solid_law` / `solid_law_goldens` | 9 / 4 / 5, all pass |
| app `golden_cl` | 25/25 |
| app `verify` | 21 pass, 2 ignored |
| app `drill_prior` / `verify_arc_reading` / `bore_entry` / `bore_facet_sagitta` / `coarse_contain` / `ladder_entry_height` | 12 / 7 / 3 / 2 / 1 / 4, all pass |
| sim lib | 86/86 |
| sim `crossing_retrace` / `crossing_buckets` | 2 / 3 |
| sim `model_excess` / `posed_rapids` / `vertical_rapids` / `coarse_collision` / `fixture_mesh_convict` / `overhang_laws` / `midmove_pose` | 5 / 5 / 16 / 5 / 5 / 13 / 5, all pass |
| clippy `-p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the rest of the quick plan's app, motion and UI list. The diff does not reach UI, and the author reports 297 app suites green on d9b36d6a.

### Requested before merge
1. **A flat or chord wall whose corners lie on the declared circle is read as the bore's wall, and the helix cuts through it silently.**
   - **Where:** `crates/sim/src/verify/thread_bore.rs:61-74` (`wall_radius`), and the same in `crates/app/src/operation/material_source.rs:342-344` (`major_rims`).
   - **Why it happens:** a facet is recognised as the wall when all three vertices are within the band of the minor circle. Its "wall radius" is then its nearest *vertex*. A planar facet whose vertices lie on the circle can still pass well inside it: a chord dips by its sagitta.
   - **What it lets through:** the grant then holds the cutter to vertex radius + H, not to where the facet really is. `major_rims` has the same flaw. `rim_is` accepts any loop of 8 or more vertices on the circle, and `near` is the nearest vertex, so the region is swapped for a full disk too.
   - **Reproduction:** the `thread_mill_rim` block with the same 6 mm pitch-1 Tap and a model-sourced `thread(0, 5)`. Each case below gives **0 blocking warnings**:

     | Model hole | Real cut past the model's wall |
     |---|---|
     | r 5 96-gon with a flat chord between (3, 4) and (-3, 4) (a D-bore) | 1.54 mm into the flat |
     | octagon with its vertices on r 5 (flats at 4.62) | 0.92 mm into each flat |
     | 16-gon on r 5 (flats at 4.90) | 0.64 mm |

   - **Control:** the same octagon mesh declared at r 5.3 (off the band) convicts with 56 gouges, so the solid law does read these meshes. On the D-bore, main's `chord_dip` gives nothing (half-chord 3 >= cutter radius 3), so all 1.54 mm comes from this grant.
   - **The mouth branch has the same flaw** (`thread_bore.rs:74`). There one on-band vertex is enough, so a facet at or above the entry that reaches inside the circle (a step or roof over part of the mouth) is capped at that vertex's radius.
   - **Fix (one possible):** measure the facet, not its vertices.
     - Take `wall` as the facet's nearest XY point to the bore axis: for a near-vertical facet, the minimum distance from the axis to its edges.
     - Recognise the wall only when that nearest point is also on the band, so a chord's sagitta must fit the band.
     - In `major_rims`, take `near` as the loop's nearest *edge* distance to the centre, not its nearest vertex.
     - A D-flat then reads 4.0 and its 5.54 mm helix convicts. A 96-gon at r 5 (2.7 um sagitta) stays clean.
   - **Pin it:** a D-bore and an octagon on r 5 with a matched `thread(0, 5)` must convict, and the existing matched cases must stay clean.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- **Pre-existing on main (not this PR):** the containment kinds' `chord_dip` hole-wall grant also lets a coarse polygon's flats be cut.
  - The same octagon with `thread(0, 4.4)`: the major circle 4.94 is off the band, so this PR's grant does not apply. It still gives 0 warnings, cutting 0.32 mm into flats at 4.62, because the chord dip for a 3 mm cutter on a 3.83 mm chord is 0.69 mm.
  - A Bore on a coarse polygon hole would see the same. Worth its own issue; I have not filed one.
- **Wrong-pitch tool:** the grant and the rim grow by `THREAD_DEPTH_PER_PITCH * tool.pitch`, and a model hole carries no pitch. A coarser-pitch tool is therefore judged against its own deeper major circle. That is the tool law of #1005, as noted before; still worth confirming it lands.
- **Crossing law:** the 1 nm `touching` reach over every op is recorded in the decision file. No further concern.
- **Size:** `generate.rs` grows a few lines on a file already far over ~400 lines. Not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 0fbce135c890aaf8d48578835af55635d6b1ad23 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (one non-blocking docs note below).

Delta re-review at 0fbce135, the merge of upstream main (PROCESS_VERSION 35) done after the review of ea76d5df. I trial-merged the head with current upstream main (beb9e5b9): clean, no conflicts. I read the whole solid-law and crossing-law surface at the safety-floor standard.

### Earlier items, one by one
1. **`contain_into` / `solid_hits_walled` / `HoleAxis` (#1205): fixed, both laws survive.**
   - `contain_into` takes main's `&OpParams` (walls from `HoleAxis::vertical`) and adds `bores: &[ThreadBore]` (`generate.rs:3278`, `:3291`).
   - `solid_hits_walled` keeps main's signature and forwards to `solid_hits_threaded(.., walls, &[])` (`solid.rs:97`).
   - In `solid_index.rs:168-175` main's `wall_excuse` is untouched. The thread grant is a separate `threaded` test, joined as `pen > ex + allow && !threaded`, so it only adds an excuse and never widens #1205's.
   - The tap-core re-read passes `&[]` (`generate.rs:3022`), as strict as main.
2. **Crossing touch (#1308 / #1129): fixed.** The PR no longer touches `crossing.rs` or `laws.rs` (`git diff upstream/main` on both is empty). The PR's `touching()` is gone. Main's `proper_cross_touch` / `CROSSING_TOUCH` is the only touch rule, and `crossing_retrace` (2 tests) passes on it. `CROSSING_TOUCH` is still exported from `verify/mod.rs`.
3. **`ix.hits` signature change: fixed.** `contact.rs:98` and `rapids_posed.rs:120` pass `&[], &[]` (no walls, no bores): no grant on those paths. `mod.rs` exports `HoleAxis`, `WALL_SAG`, `solid_hits_walled`, `solid_hits_threaded`, `ThreadBore`, `CHORD_CREDIT`.
4. **Stale PROCESS_VERSION: fixed.** The PR changes no process file and carries no bump. After the merge `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 35, equal to upstream.

Prior findings also still hold: the chord/flat wall grading (`thread_bore.rs` `wall_radius` / `plan_nearest`, `thread_rims.rs` `loop_nearest`) is intact. A D-bore flat and an octagon on the circle convict (`a_flat_whose_corners_stand_on_the_circle_convicts`), and a fine polygon stays clean.

### Laws check
- No unwrap/expect/panic outside tests in `thread_bore.rs` / `thread_rims.rs`; non-finite input reads as infinite or zero (convicts rather than excuses). Provenance lines present. The grant is Thread-only (`thread_bores` is empty for other kinds).
- The floor and any wall of another radius are never excused. No snapshot, golden, dependency, build.rs, `.github`, script or process file is touched. Body has `Changelog:` and ends `Fixes #1071`; commit subjects are conventional.
- `generate.rs` / `solid_index.rs` growth is small; `generate.rs` was already far over ~400 (not blocking).

### Local results (trial-merged with upstream main beb9e5b9, macOS, sccache)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app `thread_mill_rim` | 11/11 |
| app `mill2d_c` / `solid_law` / `solid_law_goldens` | 9 / 4 / 6, all pass |
| app `verify` | 21 pass, 2 ignored |
| app `drill_prior` / `golden_cl` | 12 / 26 |
| app `hole_wall_flats` / `hole_wall_pins` / `tap_sim` / `tapping_mode` | 4 / 5 / 8 / 4 |
| app lib | 148/148 |
| sim lib | 107/107 |
| sim integration suites (all, incl. `crossing_retrace` 2, `crossing_touch` 5, `crossing_buckets` 3, `coarse_collision`, `model_excess`, `posed_rapids`, `vertical_rapids`, `overhang_laws`) | all pass |
| clippy `-p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the rest of the quick plan's motion and UI suites (the diff does not reach them), and no machine run.

### Requested before merge
None blocking.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `docs/decisions/1071-thread-mill-rim.md` lines 8, 19 and 22 still describe the PR's own `touching` crossing change ("**Chosen (crossing law)**", "Noted (crossing law scope)"). That change was dropped in favour of main's #1129 rule, so the ledger now records a decision the PR does not make. Worth a one-line edit (or deletion of those bullets) to say the crossing fix is main's; it is a docs file and does not gate the merge.
- Wrong-pitch tool: the grant grows by `THREAD_DEPTH_PER_PITCH * tool.pitch`, and a model hole carries no pitch, so a coarser-pitch tool is judged against its own major circle (the #1005 tool law, as before).
- The `needs-rework` label on this PR was set by the maintainer against an earlier head; I leave it for the maintainer to drop.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
